title: The Year Reality Bent
narrative: Pokémon GO made augmented reality a global obsession. Facebook Live changed how the world broadcasts. Snapchat put a camera on your face. The post-truth era began. Yahoo revealed the largest data breach in history. The internet started to feel like it was everywhere — and nowhere safe.
